decisions.reason: As a distant and only lightly presented niche offer, it is more likely to fall below aspiration levels and be cut so resources can return to the core lighting business or nearer development projects.

This product builds on the firm's professional lighting capabilities, had dedicated market presentation, and an expanding R&D-active firm is likely to tolerate some uncertainty while it learns about demand.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the firm's established industrial customer base and technical strengths very well, so they are likely to meet or approach aspiration levels and be retained.

A relaunched and reportedly popular task light close to the existing offer is the kind of adjacent product a large established German lighting firm would usually continue unless results clearly deteriorate.
